rag-lane.description: RAG lane: semantic_search (ranked passages + record paths over the committed embedding index) and get (full record) — reads committed JSON, never embeds at runtime

wiki-lane.description: Wiki lane: list (tree + seven-genre taxonomy), open (full record), links (outgoing edges AND incoming backlinks — the surface most wiki tools lack)

graph-lane.description: Graph lane: neighbors (typed adjacent records, both directions, filterable) and paths (multi-hop typed-edge chains) over the five authored edge types

graph-seed-lane.description: Graph lane, seeded (F6): lookup (name/title/path → record paths + titles only, never record text) plus the frozen graph surface (neighbors, paths) — tests typed-edge traversal with an entry point
